# Ross Miller

> Software engineer and serial founder. Creator of Forge (native macOS terminal for AI coding agents), Vivy (the #1 doctor-led GLP-1 companion app), Chord Colors, Tutor, and Symphony Pro. Previously Software Engineering Manager and #2 employee at Openpath Security.

Ross Miller (also written Ross N. Miller) is a software engineer focused on architecture and user experience. He has founded multiple companies and shipped native mobile, web, and macOS products used by millions. His current focus is Forge, a native macOS tool for running many AI coding agents in parallel.

## Active projects

- [Forge](https://rossmiller.dev/forge/): Native macOS terminal manager for running many AI coding agents in parallel. Get pinged the moment an agent finishes, stalls at a prompt, or needs input. Built with SwiftUI on libghostty.
- [Vivy](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vivy-glp-1-shot-tracker/id6736508784): The #1 doctor-led GLP-1 companion app on the App Store.
- [Chord Colors](https://chordcolors.com/): Interactive music theory exploration app for iOS and Web. iOS app: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1422598441. Web: https://chordcolors.com/.
- [Tutor](https://rossmiller.dev/tutor/): AI tutor that writes books for you, answers questions, and tests your understanding. Open source: https://github.com/rsml/tutor.

## Past work

- [Openpath Security](https://www.openpath.com/): Software Engineering Manager and #2 employee. Premier access control platform powering millions of door unlocks per day. Acquired by Motorola Solutions.
- [Symphony Pro](https://symphonypro.net/): World's first iPad sheet music notation app. iOS app: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/symphony-pro-music-notation/id412380315.
- Text2Order: Order food and drink at music festivals by text message.
- GrubRunner: Order food and drink at stadium events by text message.
